method.baseline: Replay the existing passage selection rule using the two serving measurements. Report the matched journal worker output separately. A correct candidate range matches the exact changed sentence.
method.fit: AdamW at 3e-5, eight matched source pairs per batch and seed 131. Combine five-times positive-weighted sentence cross-entropy and 0.4 times a softplus margin comparing the same sentence in its original and rewritten form.
method.focus: One five-sentence source paragraph excerpt with exactly one annotated and materially changed interior sentence. Preserve four exact native neighbors and independent source groups. A source pair shares the edit position.
method.intake: Use publisher train and dev government-report shards for fitting and setting the points. Hold out new test works and two previously unseen generators. Compare dated real journal revisions using the earlier full worker.
method.model: Fine-tune the pinned six-layer encoder and linear head for four epochs. Each interior vector combines its mean token representation and its difference from the mean of its two neighbors. Use complete source-character coverage.
method.point: Calibration uses maxima from genuine dev works only. The two points allow at most ten or twenty-five percent of these works to be flagged. The held file contributes only the submitted text. At most one exact sentence is selected.
